heading: Regulations
lead: The Secretary may issue such regulations as may be necessary to carry out this chapter.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 308 of Pub. L. 92–532 was classified to section 1438 of this title, prior to repeal by section 203(1) of Pub. L. 100–627.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2000—Pub. L. 106–513 amended section catchline and text generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “If any provision of this Act or the application thereof to any person or circumstances is held invalid, the validity of the remainder of this Act and of the application of such provision to other persons and circumstances shall not be affected thereby.”
